g.text: Five owners hold 79% of the world's installed AI compute

g.text: What it shows: how concentrated ownership of installed AI compute is at 2025Q4. Each bar is one holder's share of 20.9M

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: H100e, with the running total beside it. The five largest account for 79%.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Owners (CC-BY) — cumulative_by_designer.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-owners

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI chip owners documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Concentration is the reason any estimate built on this dataset rests on a handful of figures: get Google or Microsoft wrong and the

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: total moves. "Other", "China" and "China (smuggled)" are aggregates rather than organisations, and are labelled so no reading treats

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: them as one company. "Other" ranking third is a statement about coverage, not about a third-largest company. Almost none of this is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: disclosed by the owners: Epoch estimates it from filings, supply-chain reporting and satellite work, and publishes a 5th-95th

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: percentile beside every median. OWNERS-D02 charts that interval, which is wide and very uneven.
